title: Smoky Kenyan Wild Greens Salad
description: A hearty salad featuring smoky flavors and wild greens, inspired by Kenyan cuisine.

ingredients.name: Wild greens
ingredients.notes: Any combination of wild greens such as arugula, spinach, and lettuce

ingredients.name: Smoky Kenyan spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most African markets or online

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Flaky sea salt or kosher salt

instructions: In a large bowl, combine chopped wild greens and crunchy lettuce (if using).
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice and smoky Kenyan spice blend.
Drizzle the dressing over the greens and toss to coat.
Drizzle olive oil over the salad and sprinkle with salt to taste.
Toss the salad again to combine all the flavors.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional wild greens if desired.
